findings.summary: `## Applied Waivers` can repeat one authorization once per implementation round, and the table has no round column to tell the rows apart.
findings.evidence: src/orchestrator.ts:6032-6072 emits a `waiver-applied` event on every post-QA gate phase, so a slice that repairs and re-runs the phase emits the same waiver again with a different `round`. src/logger.ts renders `## Applied Waivers` from `runEvents.filter((event) => event.type === "waiver-applied")` with columns Slice / Risk class / Path / Author / Reason only. src/orchestrator.test.ts:3494 pins one event, but that scenario is a single-round PASS, so the repeat case is unbound.
findings.expected: B-14: an `## Applied Waivers` section naming slice, risk class, exact path, author and reason for the waivers the run applied.
findings.observed: A multi-round slice would render one identical row per round, with nothing in the row distinguishing them; `saveAppliedWaivers` de-duplicates the persisted record but the summary table does not.
findings.clearCondition: The summary either de-duplicates on slice + risk class + path or carries the round the event already holds, with a logger test covering two `waiver-applied` events for one waiver in different rounds.
